rules: Abyssal Dominion is the current player-facing working title in the source and preview.
VAELTIDE remains a reserved alternative until the final brand decision; do not mix both names in one player-facing build.
SeeFight 3D may remain only in historical reconstruction reports, compatibility identifiers, recovered-file notes and old milestone evidence.
Do not mass-rename technical legacy identifiers when that could break saves, tests, recovered evidence or tooling.
